(async function () {
  const checks = [], $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const check = (value, label) => { if (!value) throw Error(label); checks.push(label); };
  const until = async (predicate) => { const end = Date.now() + 10000; while (!await predicate()) { if (Date.now() > end) throw Error("Timed out: " + predicate); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25)); } };
  const requests = () => fetch("/fixture/requests").then((response) => response.json());
  const mode = (value) => fetch("/fixture/mode", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(value) });
  const tab = () => document.querySelector('[data-tab="tasks"]');
  const card = (id) => document.querySelector('[data-task-id="' + id + '"]');
  const action = (id, name) => card(id)?.querySelector('[data-task-action="' + name + '"]');
  const settingsFields = ['main', 'develop', 'featurePrefix', 'hotfixPrefix', 'releasePrefix'];
  const setSettings = (values) => { for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) $('task-settings-' + key).value = value; };
  const openSettings = async () => { $('tasks-settings').click(); await until(() => $('task-settings-dialog').open && !$('task-settings-save').disabled); };
  const settingsRequests = async (method) => (await requests()).filter((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks/settings' && request.method === method);
  const releaseSettings = (value) => fetch('/fixture/release-settings', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(value) });
  const selectProject = async (name) => {
    [...$('project-nav').querySelectorAll('button')].find((button) => button.querySelector('.nav-name')?.textContent === name).click();
    await until(() => !$('view-project').hidden && $('p-name').textContent === name);
    tab().click();
    await until(() => !$('tab-tasks').hidden && !$('tasks-refresh').disabled);
  };
  const returnToTasks = async () => {
    if (!$('view-session').hidden) $('s-crumb-project').click();
    await until(() => !$('view-project').hidden); tab().click();
    await until(() => !$('tab-tasks').hidden && $('tasks-new'));
  };
  await until(() => $('project-nav').querySelector('button') && $('kpis').children.length === 4);
  $('project-nav').querySelector('button').click();
  await until(() => !$('view-project').hidden && tab());
  check(!(await requests()).some((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks'), 'tasks load only when opened');
  tab().click();
  await until(() => !$('tab-tasks').hidden && !$('tasks-refresh').disabled);
  check(tab().classList.contains('active') || tab().getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true', 'tasks tab selection');
  check($('tasks-list').textContent.length > 0, 'empty task guidance');
  $('tasks-new').click();

  $('task-assistant-send').click();
  await until(() => !$('task-create-draft').hidden && !$('task-assistant-prompt').disabled);
  check($('task-title').value === 'AI 로그인 초안' && !$('task-create-advanced').open, 'AI returns an editable draft with advanced choices collapsed');
  check(!(await requests()).some(request => request.method === 'POST' && request.path === '/api/tasks'), 'draft generation does not create a task');
  $('task-content').value = '사용자가 편집한 범위';

  check(revised.history.length === 2 && revised.draft.content === '사용자가 편집한 범위', 'same conversation sends previous turns and user-edited fields');
  await mode({ assistantFailure: true }); $('task-assistant-prompt').value = '다시 정리'; $('task-assistant-prompt').dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); $('task-assistant-send').click();
  await until(() => $('task-assistant-error').textContent.includes('초안 생성 실패'));
  check($('task-content').value === '사용자가 편집한 범위' && $('task-assistant-prompt').value === '다시 정리', 'draft failure preserves the prompt and editable content');
  await mode({ assistantFailure: false, holdAssistant: true }); $('task-assistant-send').click();

  $('task-create-manual').click();

  check([...$('task-agent').options].map((option) => option.value).join() === 'codex' && $('task-agent').value === 'codex', 'only CLIs found on this machine can be chosen');
  check($('task-permission').value !== 'read-only', 'worker starts with editing permission');
  $('task-type').value = 'release'; $('task-type').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  check($('task-version').required && !$('task-version').disabled, 'release requires version');
  $('task-type').value = 'feature'; $('task-type').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  $('task-title').value = '로그인 버튼 수정';
  await mode({ holdCreate: true });
  $('new-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-create-submit'));
  await until(() => $('task-create-submit').disabled);
  $('new-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-create-submit'));
  await until(async () => (await requests()).some((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks' && request.method === 'POST'));
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 60));
  check((await requests()).filter((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks' && request.method === 'POST').length === 1, 'duplicate create submit is blocked');
  check((await requests()).find((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks' && request.method === 'POST').body.worktree === false, 'new task works in the original folder by default when it is free');
  await fetch('/fixture/release', { method: 'POST' });
  await until(() => !$('new-task-dialog').open && !$('view-session').hidden);
  const created = (await requests()).find((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks' && request.method === 'POST').body;
  check(created.start === undefined && !(await requests()).some((request) => request.method === 'POST' && /\/api\/sessions\/[^/]+\/messages$/.test(request.path)), 'new task does not send the first request by itself');
  await until(() => $('s-prompt').value === '로그인 버튼 수정');
  check(document.activeElement === $('s-prompt'), 'new task leaves the request in the focused session input');
  $('s-prompt').value = ''; $('s-prompt').dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
  await returnToTasks();
  await until(() => card('task-1'));
  check(card('task-1').textContent.includes('feature/task-1') && card('task-1').textContent.includes('develop'), 'created task shows GitFlow branch and target');
  check(action('task-1', 'open-session'), 'task links its session');
  const more = card('task-1').querySelector('.task-more');
  more.open = true;
  // 메뉴를 위로 펼칠지는 열린 뒤에 정해진다. 전체 테스트 부하에서는 두 프레임보다 늦을 수 있어 자리를 잡을 때까지 기다린다.
  const menuVisible = () => {
    const menuRect = more.querySelector('.task-more-menu').getBoundingClientRect();
    const lastItem = [...more.querySelectorAll('.task-more-menu button')].at(-1).getBoundingClientRect();
    return more.querySelector('.task-more-menu').contains(document.elementFromPoint(lastItem.left + 8, lastItem.top + lastItem.height / 2)) && menuRect.height > lastItem.height;
  };
  await until(menuVisible).catch(() => {});
  check(menuVisible(), 'task more menu is not clipped by its card');
  more.open = false;
  action('task-1', 'open-session').click();
  await until(() => !$('view-session').hidden && $('s-title').textContent === '로그인 버튼 수정');

  } }) });

  check($('s-events').querySelector('[data-report-task="task-1"]').textContent === '로그인 작업', 'session answers render task URIs as clickable references');
  localStorage.setItem('agenthub-project-tab', 'flow');
  $('s-events').querySelector('[data-report-task="task-1"]').click();

  check(tab().getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true' && $('p-name').textContent === 'Fixture', 'task reference opens the owning project tasks tab');
  check(document.activeElement === card('task-1') && card('task-1').tabIndex === -1, 'task reference focuses its existing card');
  await mode({ reviewScenario: true });
  action('task-1', 'finish').click();
  await until(() => $('finish-task-dialog').open && $('task-finish-files').querySelectorAll('input').length === 2);
  $('task-finish-message').value = 'fix: 로그인 버튼 수정';
  const remainingFile = $('task-finish-files').querySelector('input[value="remaining.txt"]');

  $('task-finish-files').querySelector('button').click();
  await until(() => $('task-finish-diff').textContent.includes('+ selected change'));
  $('finish-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-finish-submit'));

  const pickedCommit = (await requests()).find(request => request.path === '/api/tasks/task-1/commit');
  check(pickedCommit.body.files.length === 1 && pickedCommit.body.files[0] === 'chosen.txt' && pickedCommit.body.reviewToken, 'review commits only selected files with a snapshot guard');
  check($('finish-task-dialog').open && $('task-finish-submit').textContent === '선택 파일 커밋', 'remaining files stay in the commit step');
  $('finish-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-finish-submit'));

  $('finish-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-finish-submit'));
  await until(() => !$('task-finish-verify-row').hidden && !$('task-finish-refresh').disabled);

  $('task-finish-description').value = '버튼 동작을 고칩니다.';
  $('task-finish-verification').value = '테스트 통과';
  $('task-finish-verified').checked = true; $('task-finish-verified').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  $('finish-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-finish-submit'));
  await until(() => !$('finish-task-dialog').open && card('task-1')?.querySelector('a[href="https://github.com/fixture/repo/pull/42"]'));
  check(card('task-1').textContent.includes('검토 대기') && card('task-1').querySelector('[data-step="pr"][aria-current="step"]'), 'finishing opens PR and enters review');
  const finished = (await requests()).find((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks/task-1/finish');
  check(finished?.body.message === 'fix: 로그인 버튼 수정' && finished.body.verification === '테스트 통과', 'finish sends commit and verification details');
  $('tasks-new').click();
  $('task-create-manual').click();
  await until(() => $('new-task-dialog').open && !$('task-create-submit').disabled);
  $('task-title').value = '긴급 수정 <img src=x onerror="window.taskInjected=1">'; $('task-type').value = 'hotfix'; $('task-type').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  $('task-worktree').value = 'none'; $('task-worktree').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  $('task-permission').value = 'read-only';
  const postCount = async () => (await requests()).filter((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks' && request.method === 'POST').length;
  const postsBefore = await postCount();
  await mode({ inPlaceBusy: true });
  $('new-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-create-submit'));
  await until(() => document.querySelector('dialog.confirm-dialog[open]'));
  check(document.querySelector('dialog.confirm-dialog[open]').textContent.includes('다른 작업') && document.querySelector('dialog.confirm-dialog[open]').textContent.includes('워크트리'), 'a busy original folder asks whether to create a worktree');
  document.querySelector('dialog.confirm-dialog[open] button[value="cancel"]').click();
  await until(() => !document.querySelector('dialog.confirm-dialog[open]') && !$('task-create-submit').disabled);
  check($('new-task-dialog').open && await postCount() === postsBefore && $('task-worktree').value === 'none', 'declining the worktree keeps the form without creating a task');
  $('new-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-create-submit'));
  await until(() => document.querySelector('dialog.confirm-dialog[open]'));
  document.querySelector('dialog.confirm-dialog[open] [data-confirm-ok]').click();
  await until(() => !$('new-task-dialog').open && !$('view-session').hidden);
  check((await requests()).filter((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks' && request.method === 'POST').at(-1).body.worktree === undefined, 'accepting creates the task with a worktree');
  await mode({ inPlaceBusy: false });
  await returnToTasks(); await until(() => card('task-2'));
  check(card('task-2').textContent.includes('hotfix/task-2') && card('task-2').textContent.includes('main'), 'hotfix targets main');
  check(!card('task-2').querySelector('img') && !window.taskInjected && card('task-2').textContent.includes('<img'), 'task titles render as text');
  await mode({ uncertain: true });
  action('task-2', 'finish').click(); await until(() => $('finish-task-dialog').open && !$('task-finish-verify-row').hidden && !$('task-finish-refresh').disabled);
  $('task-finish-message').value = 'fix: 긴급 수정';
  $('task-finish-verified').checked = true; $('task-finish-verified').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  $('finish-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-finish-submit'));
  await until(() => document.body.textContent.includes('중복 실행'));

  if ($('finish-task-dialog').open) $('finish-task-dialog').close();

  await until(() => card('task-2')?.querySelector('.task-state')?.textContent === '검토 대기');

  check((await requests()).filter((request) => request.path === '/api/tasks/task-2/finish').length === 1, 'recovery only reads PR state');

  await until(() => document.body.textContent.includes('원격 확인 실패'));

  await until(() => !$('tasks-refresh').disabled);

  check($('task-settings-main').value === 'main' && $('task-settings-develop').value === 'develop', 'branch settings show current project defaults');

  $('task-settings-develop').value = 'Canceled'; $('task-settings-cancel').click();
  await openSettings();
  check($('task-settings-develop').value === 'develop' && (await settingsRequests('PUT')).length === 0, 'canceling branch settings does not save edits');

  check($('task-settings-save').disabled && settingsFields.every((key) => $('task-settings-' + key).disabled), 'failed settings load cannot overwrite project settings');
  $('task-settings-cancel').click(); await mode({ settingsReadFailure: false });
  $('tasks-new').click(); await until(() => $('new-task-dialog').open);
  $('task-create-manual').click();
  check($('task-title').value === '' && $('task-type').value === 'hotfix' && $('task-worktree').value === 'none' && $('task-permission').value === 'read-only', 'new task remembers the previous task settings but not its title, and always starts in the original folder');
  check([...document.querySelectorAll('.task-folder')].some(line => line.querySelector('.task-folder-kind')?.textContent === '워크트리' && /fixture.agenthub[\/]task-/.test(line.querySelector('.task-folder-path')?.textContent || '')), 'task cards show the folder kind and full worktree path');
  check(/원본 폴더(.*)를 새 작업 브랜치로/.test($('task-worktree-hint').textContent), 'the original folder default explains that its branch will change');

  check(saved.search.includes('C%3A%2Ffixture') && JSON.stringify(saved.body.settings) === JSON.stringify(custom), 'settings save sends case-sensitive names for the active project');
  await releaseSettings({ save: true });
  await until(() => !$('task-settings-dialog').open && !$('tasks-refresh').disabled);

  check($('task-branch-preview').textContent === 'Develop에서 Feature/보존할-작업-제목 생성 → Develop으로 PR', 'feature preview uses custom case-sensitive branch settings and a name made from the title');

  $('task-type').value = 'hotfix'; $('task-type').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));

  check($('task-branch-preview').textContent === 'Develop에서 Release/1.2.3 생성 → Main으로 PR', 'release preview uses the configured branches and prefix');
  $('task-create-cancel').click();
  check(card('task-1').textContent.includes('feature/task-1 → develop') && card('task-2').textContent.includes('hotfix/task-2 → main'), 'existing task cards retain their original GitFlow snapshot');

  $('task-title').value = '기존 브랜치에서 이어서 작업';
  $('task-workbranch-mode').value = 'existing'; $('task-workbranch-mode').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  await until(() => [...$('task-workbranch').options].some(option => option.value === 'feature/selected'));
  check([...$('task-workbranch').options].find(option => option.value === 'main')?.disabled, 'task picker blocks source branch');
  check([...$('task-workbranch').options].find(option => option.value === 'feature/locked')?.disabled, 'task picker blocks locked worktree');
  check([...$('task-workbranch').options].find(option => option.value === 'feature/task-1')?.disabled, 'task picker blocks duplicate task ownership');
  $('task-workbranch').value = 'feature/selected'; $('task-workbranch').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  await until(() => !$('task-create-submit').disabled);
  $('new-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-create-submit'));
  await until(() => !$('new-task-dialog').open && !$('view-session').hidden);
  await returnToTasks(); await until(() => card('task-4'));
  check(card('task-4').textContent.includes('feature/selected'), 'new task reuses selected workbranch');
  check((await requests()).filter(request => request.path === '/api/tasks' && request.method === 'POST').at(-1).body.workBranch === 'feature/selected', 'task sends selected branch instead of creating another');
  $('open-new').click(); await until(() => $('new-dialog').open);
  $('new-agent').value = 'codex'; $('new-agent').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  $('new-isolate').value = 'true'; $('new-isolate').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  $('new-worktree-mode').value = 'existing'; $('new-worktree-mode').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  await until(() => [...$('new-worktree-branch').options].some(option => option.value === 'feature/selected'));
  $('new-worktree-branch').value = 'feature/selected'; $('new-worktree-branch').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  $('new-title').value = '기존 작업 검토'; await until(() => !$('new-submit').disabled);
  $('new-form').requestSubmit($('new-submit')); await until(() => !$('new-dialog').open);
  const selectedSession = (await requests()).filter(request => request.path === '/api/sessions' && request.method === 'POST').at(-1);
  check(selectedSession?.body.workBranch === 'feature/selected' && selectedSession.body.isolate === false && !('worktreeName' in selectedSession.body), 'session picker shares the selected branch');
  check((await requests()).filter(request => request.path === '/api/workbranches').length >= 2, 'tasks and sessions use the same branch list API');
  // 아래 화면 크기 검사는 설정 창이 열린 상태를 본다.
  await returnToTasks(); await until(() => action('task-4', 'link-issue'));
  // 작업에 GitHub 이슈를 연결한다. 로그인 오류에는 GitHub 로그인 버튼을 함께 보여 준다.
  action('task-4', 'link-issue').click(); await until(() => $('task-issue-dialog').open);
  $('task-issue-number').value = '13'; $('task-issue-form').requestSubmit($('task-issue-submit'));
  await until(() => !$('task-issue-error').hidden);
  check($('task-issue-error').querySelector('.task-login')?.textContent === 'GitHub 로그인', 'issue login failure offers GitHub login');
  $('task-issue-number').value = '7'; $('task-issue-form').requestSubmit($('task-issue-submit'));
  await until(() => !$('task-issue-dialog').open && card('task-4')?.querySelector('.task-issue'));
  check(card('task-4').querySelector('.task-issue').textContent.includes('이슈 #7 · 열림'), 'linked issue state is shown on the task card');
  check(card('task-4').querySelector('.task-issue a')?.href === 'https://github.com/fixture/repo/issues/7', 'linked issue opens on GitHub');
  check(action('task-4', 'unlink-issue') && !action('task-4', 'link-issue'), 'linked issue can be unlinked');
  // GitFlow 단계 노선: 진행 중인 작업은 작업 단계에 있고, 할 수 없는 마무리는 이유와 함께 꺼진다.
  await until(() => card('task-4')?.querySelector('[data-step="work"][aria-current="step"]'));
  check(card('task-4').querySelector('.task-state').textContent === '진행 중' && card('task-4').querySelector('[data-step="base"]')?.textContent.includes('Develop'), 'task card shows stage and base branch');
  check(card('task-4').querySelector('#task-reason-task-4')?.textContent.includes('아직 변경이 없습니다'), 'disabled next action explains why');
  const finishPrimary = [...card('task-4').querySelectorAll('[data-task-action="finish"]')].find(button => button.textContent === '마무리');
  check(finishPrimary?.disabled && finishPrimary.getAttribute('aria-describedby') === 'task-reason-task-4', 'disabled primary action is linked to its reason');
  check(card('task-2').querySelector('[data-step="back"]')?.textContent.includes('develop'), 'hotfix shows develop back-merge stage');
  // 되돌리기 어려운 동작은 변경 요약 확인 창을 띄우고, 취소하면 요청을 보내지 않는다.
  const deletes = async () => (await requests()).filter(request => request.method === 'DELETE' && request.path.startsWith('/api/tasks/task-4')).length;
  const before = await deletes();
  action('task-4', 'delete').click();
  await until(() => document.querySelector('dialog.confirm-dialog[open]'));
  const confirmBox = document.querySelector('dialog.confirm-dialog[open]');
  check(confirmBox.textContent.includes('바뀌는 것') && confirmBox.textContent.includes('그대로 남는 것') && confirmBox.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]'), 'delete confirmation summarizes changes with a branch option');
  confirmBox.querySelector('button[value="cancel"]').click();
  await until(() => !document.querySelector('dialog.confirm-dialog'));
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  check(await deletes() === before && card('task-4'), 'cancelled delete changes nothing');
  // 상태 필터: 진행 중·완료로 나눠 보고, 고른 필터를 기억한다.
  const states = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.task-card .task-state')].map(item => item.dataset.state);
  const total = states().length;
  document.querySelector('[data-task-filter="done"]').click();
  check(states().every(state => ['merged', 'cleaned'].includes(state)) && document.querySelector('[data-task-filter="done"]').getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true', 'done filter shows only finished tasks');
  check(localStorage.getItem('agenthub.taskFilter') === 'done', 'the chosen task filter is remembered');
  document.querySelector('[data-task-filter="active"]').click();
  check(states().length && states().every(state => ['working', 'review'].includes(state)), 'active filter shows only tasks in progress');
  const counts = Object.fromEntries([...document.querySelectorAll('#tasks-filter [data-task-filter]')].map(button => [button.dataset.taskFilter, Number(button.querySelector('[data-task-count]').textContent || 0)]));
  check(counts.all === total && counts.active + counts.done === total, 'filter counts add up to all tasks');
  document.querySelector('[data-task-filter="all"]').click();
  check(states().length === total, 'all filter shows every task again');
  // 작업 그만두기: 원격까지 지운다는 확인을 받고, 확인하면 카드가 사라진다.
  check(action('task-4', 'abandon') && [...document.querySelectorAll('.task-card')].filter(item => ['merged', 'cleaned'].includes(item.querySelector('.task-state').dataset.state)).every(item => !item.querySelector('[data-task-action="abandon"]')), 'only unfinished tasks offer abandon');
  action('task-4', 'abandon').click();
  await until(() => document.querySelector('dialog.confirm-dialog[open]'));
  const abandonBox = document.querySelector('dialog.confirm-dialog[open]');
  check(abandonBox.textContent.includes('원격 브랜치') && abandonBox.textContent.includes('작업 폴더를 지웁니다'), 'abandon confirmation lists the folder and the remote branch');
  [...abandonBox.querySelectorAll('button')].find(button => button.textContent === '그만두기').click();
  await until(() => !card('task-4'));
  check((await requests()).some(request => request.method === 'POST' && request.path === '/api/tasks/task-4/abandon' && request.body.force === false), 'abandon is requested once without forcing');
  $('tasks-new').click();
  await until(() => $('new-task-dialog').open);
  $('task-create-manual').click();
  $('task-title').value = '끝난 작업 폴더에서 이어서';
  check($('task-reuse-row').hidden, 'existing worktree list stays hidden until chosen');
  $('task-worktree').value = 'reuse'; $('task-worktree').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  await until(() => [...$('task-reuse-worktree').options].some(option => option.value === 'C:/fixture.agenthub/finished'));
  check(!$('task-reuse-row').hidden && !$('task-reuse-row').closest('details'), 'existing worktree picker appears next to the folder choice');
  check([...$('task-reuse-worktree').options].find(option => option.value === 'C:/fixture.agenthub/dirty')?.disabled, 'worktree picker blocks a worktree with uncommitted changes');
  check($('task-create-submit').disabled && $('task-worktree-name-row').hidden, 'creation waits for a worktree and hides the folder name');
  $('task-reuse-worktree').value = 'C:/fixture.agenthub/finished'; $('task-reuse-worktree').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  await until(() => !$('task-create-submit').disabled);
  check(/C:\/fixture.agenthub\/finished를 새 작업 브랜치로/.test($('task-worktree-hint').textContent) && /끝난 작업/.test($('task-reuse-status').textContent), 'chosen worktree explains that its folder switches to the new branch');
  $('new-task-form').requestSubmit($('task-create-submit'));
  await until(() => !$('new-task-dialog').open);
  const reusedPost = (await requests()).filter(request => request.path === '/api/tasks' && request.method === 'POST').at(-1).body;
  check(reusedPost.worktreePath === 'C:/fixture.agenthub/finished' && !('worktreeName' in reusedPost) && !('workBranch' in reusedPost) && reusedPost.worktree === undefined, 'task sends the chosen worktree instead of creating a folder');
  await returnToTasks();
  await until(() => !$('tasks-settings').disabled); await openSettings();
  return checks;
})()
